_note: Gemini's original: id, name, archetype, role, avatar_file, catchphrase, the first 3 stats, easter_egg. Added by Claude (change freely): color, backstory_short, skills, the last 2 stats. The in-game ability and weakness live in engine.js (PERKS); the first skill and the negative skill describe them.

game_roster.name: BigWman
game_roster.easter_egg: Gets a panic notification every time a new package of 'essentials' is delivered to the door.
game_roster.backstory_short: The squad's CFO and tank. He has a spreadsheet for everything, including the zombie apocalypse. His wallet defence is weaker: there is always a new package at the door.

skills.name: Excel Mastery
skills.effect: IN GAME: your combo lasts 60 % longer before it drops.

skills.name: YES! Energy
skills.effect: A roaring YES! that lifts the whole squad.

skills.name: Polestar Getaway
skills.effect: The EV is silent. Nobody hears him roll away.

skills.name: Big Frame
skills.effect: Takes one more hit before he even notices.

skills.name: Package Panic
skills.effect: IN GAME: packages lie on the floor. Touch one and you freeze to sign for it.

game_roster.name: Wizcudi
game_roster.easter_egg: Sneaks around switching off devices to save the electricity bill while Anna and Ellie switch them back on.
game_roster.backstory_short: Knows every midlane matchup and every kilowatt-hour in the house. Zombies are a problem. A light left on in an empty room is a disaster.

skills.name: Light Switch Reflex
skills.effect: IN GAME: you see 40 % further in the dark.

skills.name: Meter Shield
skills.effect: The electricity meter is protected. No energy is wasted.

skills.name: Galaxy Brain
skills.effect: Game Knowledge 10. Sees three moves ahead.

skills.name: Refresh Reflex
skills.effect: Refreshes the app faster than anyone in Sweden.

skills.name: Jungle Fear
skills.effect: IN GAME: you are slower outside in the garden.

game_roster.name: Jrohn
game_roster.easter_egg: Loses one piece of clothing per mission and chases Walter, who keeps running away from home.
game_roster.backstory_short: The support who loves everything, even zombies. Grows almost anything and sprints after Walter when he escapes. His clothes disappear one piece at a time. Nobody knows what is in the basement.

skills.name: Sprint After Walter
skills.effect: IN GAME: you run 20 % faster.

skills.name: I Love This!
skills.effect: Enthusiasm 10. Never stressed, however many zombies there are.

skills.name: Green Fingers
skills.effect: Everything he plants grows. Even health.

skills.name: Support Aura
skills.effect: Friends near him feel a little better.

skills.name: Progressive Disrobing
skills.effect: IN GAME: get too close to furniture and your pants drop. Stand still to pull them up.

game_roster.name: Löken
game_roster.easter_egg: Drops coins from his pockets as he walks and goes into defence mode as soon as a weed appears.
game_roster.backstory_short: The glue that holds the squad together, in golden armour. His lawn is perfect and his loyalty cannot be shaken. Coins fall out of his pockets wherever he goes.

skills.name: ATM Security
skills.effect: IN GAME: your shield blocks one hit every 20 seconds.

skills.name: Loyalty
skills.effect: IN GAME: hugs from the kids give 2 hearts instead of 1.

skills.name: Perfect Lawn
skills.effect: Defence mode the moment a weed (or a zombie) appears.

skills.name: Iron Stoves
skills.effect: The Djurgården song gives the squad a little extra power.

skills.name: Coin Leak
skills.effect: IN GAME: you drop coins now and then. Clink clink. Zombies hear it.

game_roster.name: Ljunky
game_roster.catchphrase: Have you checked the Bitcoin price today?
game_roster.easter_egg: Catches fragile things in mid-air when his two cats knock them off the shelves.
game_roster.backstory_short: Jungle, botlane and the rulebook in one person. Fit, accurate and always ready to buy the dip. At home, two cats knock everything off the shelves.

skills.name: Ranger Aim
skills.effect: IN GAME: you shoot 35 % faster and 25 % further.

skills.name: Peak Fitness
skills.effect: Fitness 10. Runs the longest without getting tired.

skills.name: Air Catch
skills.effect: Catches anything that falls, before it breaks.

skills.name: HODL
skills.effect: The worse it goes, the more he believes in it.

skills.name: Cat Chaos
skills.effect: IN GAME: now and then the cat bolts through the house and makes a lot of noise.
